name: FIRECRACKER
inspired_by: Draws on the kid-size fighters that did almost all of the 2025 fighting and still box in 2026. The Unitree G1 (1.32 m, 35 kg, 90/120 N·m knees) fought at CMG Hangzhou, WAIC, WHRG 2025, REK1, UFB at CES 2026 and WRC 2026; Booster's T1 (1.18 m, 30 kg) fought at Silicon Colosseum. It keeps their size, 23 DoF, 120 N·m knee class, gloves and padded headgear. It deliberately changes the chest to a rounded pebble shell (not a boxy flat front) and the palette to tangerine and graphite (not satin silver). The head gets three round lenses in a downward triangle instead of a black dome with a glowing halo ring. The headgear is open-face and unbranded, and there are no twin thigh stripes and no orange ankle rods.
tagline: Thirty-eight kilos of fast hands, back up before the count starts.
proportions: Builder scale 0.667, bulk 0.95: 1.30 m and 37.9 kg compiled, stance COM at 0.66 m. Thigh and shin are 0.293 m each, about 8% shorter than a 1.30 m human's (0.32 m, Winter's segment ratios). Arm reach from shoulder, fist included, is 0.48 m, 15% short of a human's 0.57 m; the builder's arm ratio is fixed. Shoulder-joint span is 0.39 m, 17% wider than a human's 0.34 m shoulders, and hip-joint span is 0.15 m. Torso 0.22 m deep × 0.32 wide × 0.32 tall; head 0.15 × 0.13 × 0.16 m. Built like a squat, wide-shouldered bantam with the lowest COM in the roster.
actuators: Hips (yaw/roll/pitch) and ankles, builder slot `leg`: CubeMars AK10-9 V3 QDD, 53 N·m peak / 18 rated, 320 rpm no-load (33.5 rad/s), 0.96 kg, 9:1, 48 V (https://www.cubemars.com/product/ak10-9-v3-0-kv60-robotic-actuator.html). Knees: RobStride 04 QDD, 120 N·m peak / 40 rated, 200 rpm (20.9 rad/s), 1.42 kg, 9:1, the same 120 N·m as a G1 EDU knee (https://github.com/RobStride/Product_Information, https://www.unitree.com/g1/). Shoulders: RobStride 06, 36 N·m peak / 11 rated, 480 rpm (50.3 rad/s), 0.621 kg, 9:1 (https://www.robstride.com/products/robStride06). Elbows: RobStride 02, 17 N·m / 7 rated, 410 rpm (42.9 rad/s), 0.405 kg, 7.75:1 (https://github.com/RobStride/Product_Information). Waist yaw and pitch: RobStride 03, 60 N·m / 21 rated, 195 rpm (20.4 rad/s), 0.90 kg, 9:1 (same source). Neck: RobStride 00, 14 N·m, 315 rpm, 0.31 kg, 10:1 (same source). 23 actuators totalling 19.1 kg. Gyro core: 50 N·m, 17 N·m·s, 2.3 kg (6% of mass). It does not need a big one. Gyro demand scales with m·g·h, and FIRECRACKER's m·g·h is 244 N·m, a quarter of HAYMAKER's. Sizing rule: H = 0.071 s·mgh, τ = 0.205·mgh, 7.5 N·m·s per kg; anchors are the Airbus CMG 15-45 S at a 3.0 s⁻¹ torque/momentum ratio and the Seakeeper 1 at 6 N·m·s/kg. Catalog ids: qdd.ak10, qdd.rs04, qdd.rs06, qdd.rs02, qdd.rs03, qdd.rs00.
materials: Armor 'polycarb' (polycarbonate shells) over a frame of 'al6061' (6061-T6 aluminium). Target fists are 8-oz-class foam boxing gloves, about 0.23 kg each; the builder's AR500 'block' fist stands in until a glove kit exists. A glove keeps impulse about the same, lowers peak force and stretches contact to 18–29 ms, per Nakano et al., ISBS 2009. Open-face EVA-foam padded headgear with cheek pads and a brow roll. Rubber soles (builder default). headBreakImpulseNs 32 as a starting value, raised about 30% for the headgear (tuning choice; calibrate with tools/fight-sim.ts).
look: Compact and rounded. The chest is a smooth pebble- or egg-shaped gloss shell, widest at the top with no flat front. Below it is a small hexagonal graphite belly plate, with a single warm-white chevron on the sternum. The head is a squat rounded trapezoid, wider at the jaw. It has three round warm-white lenses (#FFF1DC) in a downward-pointing triangle: two at brow level and one centred at mouth level, each in a graphite bezel, plus a short louvered chin vent. Fight gear is open-face padded headgear and boxing gloves with white cuffs, both in the corner colour (red or blue) with no lettering. Rounded tangerine shells cover the thighs and shins. Dark graphite cylindrical actuator pucks are exposed at shoulders, hips and knees; the forearms are slim and ribbed in graphite, and a narrow graphite waist drum is visible. The feet are rounded graphite shoe shells with tangerine toe caps and black rubber soles. Colours: gloss tangerine #F26B1D, graphite #2A2826, warm-white optics. Race number 07 on the left chest and right thigh; no logos. Default skin: 'racing' now, a new 'tangerine' skin later.
fight_style: A swarmer. It sprints inside a taller robot's kicking range and throws volume: jab-cross into hooks and uppercuts to the body and chin. It chops the lead knee with low kicks, and front kicks shove bigger robots off their base. Its weapon is recovery. With the lowest COM (0.66 m) and the smallest fall (about 245 J), it should meet URKL's 3-second get-up standard more often than anyone and be back punching before the count. Weaknesses: 0.48 m reach, 120 N·m knees, and it cannot kick a tall robot's head, so head_kick is left out.
art_prompt: Photoreal full-body concept render of a compact kid-size electric humanoid boxing robot, about 1.3 meters tall, three-quarter view, crouched bouncing boxing stance, weight on the balls of its feet, gloves up at chin height. Smooth pebble-shaped gloss tangerine-orange chest shell, small hexagonal dark graphite belly plate, rounded tangerine thigh and shin shells, exposed dark graphite cylindrical actuator housings at shoulders, hips and knees, slim ribbed graphite forearms, a single warm-white chevron on the sternum. Squat rounded-trapezoid head with three round warm-white glowing lenses arranged in a downward-pointing triangle, worn under open-face red padded boxing headgear with cheek pads and a brow roll, matching red boxing gloves with white cuffs. Rounded graphite feet with tangerine toe caps and black rubber soles. Light scuffs on paint edges, machined aluminum details. Dark charcoal studio background, soft key light, cool rim light, subtle floor reflection, 85mm lens, photoreal, high detail. No text, no numbers, no logos.

name: SAVATE
inspired_by: Draws on the adult-size fighter that made 2026 fights look like real kickboxing: EngineAI's T800 (173 cm, 75–85 kg, 450 N·m) in URKL Shenzhen (16 Jul 2026), URKL Shanghai (19 Sep 2026), REK2 and CyberHero Riyadh. Those fights brought committed roundhouse and tornado kicks, jumping knees, kip-ups and a head knocked clean off. It keeps the height, the 450 N·m knee class, bare fists and kick-first fighting. It deliberately changes the head to a narrow wedge with a single vertical light bar, instead of a dome helmet with a horizontal LED visor. The chest gets a faceted diamond plate instead of a round emblem. The palette is aubergine and bone, not white/grey, gold chrome or gunmetal and red. The joints are purchasable MyActuator modules, not the maker's own.
tagline: A 450 N·m kickboxer. The shins are the weapon.
proportions: Builder scale 0.887, bulk 0.92: 1.73 m and 82.9 kg compiled, stance COM at 0.85 m. Thigh and shin are 0.39 m each, about 8% short of a human's; leg length to the sole is about 0.85 m (the T800's is 0.91 m). Arm reach, fist included, is 0.64 m, 16% short of a human's 0.76 m (the T800 arm is 0.60 m). Shoulder-joint span is 0.51 m, 13% wider than a human's 0.45 m; hip span 0.20 m. Torso 0.28 × 0.41 × 0.43 m; head 0.20 × 0.18 × 0.21 m. Athletic, with a slightly tapered waist.
actuators: Hips (yaw/roll/pitch) and ankles, slot `leg`: MyActuator RMD-X12-P20-320-E planetary, 320 N·m peak / 85 rated, 125 rpm no-load (13.1 rad/s), 2.37 kg, 20:1, 48 V, 100 A rms peak (https://openelab.io/products/myactuator-rmd-x12-p20-actuator). Knees: MyActuator RMD-X15-P20-450-E, 450 N·m peak / 145 rated, 108 rpm (11.3 rad/s), 3.5 kg, 20.25:1, 72 V (https://openelab.io/products/myactuator-rmd-x15-p20-actuator); that is the 450 N·m class EngineAI quotes (https://en.engineai.com.cn/product-t800). Shoulders and waist: RobStride 04, 120 N·m, 200 rpm (20.9 rad/s), 1.42 kg (https://github.com/RobStride/Product_Information). Elbows: RobStride 03, 60 N·m, 20.4 rad/s, 0.90 kg. Neck: RobStride 02 (existing servo.neck). 23 actuators totalling 44.3 kg. Knee torque per kg is 5.4 N·m/kg, against the T800's 5.3–6.0 and STRIKER's 3.1. Option: M107-class hips (360 N·m, 189 N·m/kg, about 1.9 kg, https://www.unitree.com/h1/) bring it to 79.7 kg, inside the 80 kg class, but no speed is published. The 20:1 joints backdrive less than 9:1 QDD, so they are more exposed to gear damage under impact. Gyro core: 140 N·m, 49 N·m·s, 6.5 kg (7.8%), from m·g·h = 689 N·m. Catalog ids: plan.x12, plan.x15, qdd.rs04, qdd.rs03, servo.neck.
materials: Armor 'polycarb' (polycarbonate shells, like production humanoid covers) over a frame of 'al7075' (7075-T6); the T800 itself uses aviation aluminium plus titanium. Bare AR500 knuckle plates, which is the builder's 'block' fist and matches URKL's bare-fisted T800s. EVA-foam shin guards over the polycarbonate shin shells (visual now; a softer shin contact would be a builder addition). No headgear; headBreakImpulseNs 45, so a clean head kick in a mirror match can decapitate.
look: Athletic, with a tapered waist. The head is a narrow forward-raked wedge, longer front-to-back than wide, in satin aubergine. One thin pale-mint vertical light bar (#9DFFD6) runs from brow to chin on the centreline, flanked by two small round cheek sensors in brushed-aluminium bezels. There is no horizontal visor. The chest is a faceted diamond (kite) plate pointing down to the waist, with a raised centre ridge and separate side plates, over a split two-panel hip skirt. Long aubergine thigh plates sit over brushed-aluminium structure (#B9BCC0). Bone-white (#E9E2D0) ribbed foam shin guards cover the shins and insteps. Exposed ring-shaped bearing housings in brushed aluminium carry dark graphite motor cans at every joint. The fists are compact and bare, with raised knuckle plates. The feet are black-soled with aubergine heel counters. Colour: satin aubergine #3D1F4F. Number 21 on the chest diamond's left facet and on both shin guards; no logos. Default skin: 'neon' now, a new 'aubergine' skin later.
fight_style: An orthodox kickboxer. It measures with the jab and chops the lead leg with low kicks until the opponent's stance or gyro gives, then goes upstairs with the head kick. The front kick stops pressure fighters, sprint cuts the angle, and jab-cross-hook combinations finish into a kick. It is the roster's most human-looking fighter. Weaknesses: bare fists, no headgear, polycarbonate that dents, and 20:1 legs that are the most exposed to gear damage when it eats a hard counter mid-kick.
art_prompt: Photoreal full-body concept render of an adult-size electric humanoid kickboxing robot, 1.73 meters tall, athletic narrow-waisted build, three-quarter view, bladed kickboxing stance with rear heel raised and bare armored fists up. Satin aubergine-purple shells: a faceted diamond-shaped chest plate pointing down to the waist with a raised center ridge, a split two-panel hip skirt, long sculpted thigh plates; bone-white ribbed foam shin guards covering shins and insteps; brushed aluminum upper-arm and thigh structure with exposed ring-shaped bearing housings and dark graphite motor cans. Narrow forward-raked wedge-shaped head in aubergine with one thin pale-mint glowing vertical light bar running from brow to chin down its centerline and two small round cheek sensors. Compact bare mechanical fists with raised knuckle plates. Black-soled feet with aubergine heel counters. Dark studio background, cool rim light, light haze, photoreal, high detail. No text, no numbers, no logos.

name: HAYMAKER
inspired_by: It does not copy any robot that has fought. It takes the adult-size electric class (Unitree H2: 1.82 m, 70 kg, 360 N·m legs, 120 N·m arms; T800: 450 N·m) and scales it up to the heaviest mass a 450 N·m electric knee should carry: 4.4 N·m/kg, against the T800's 5.6 and the H1's 7.7. That is above WHRG 2026's 80 kg top Free Combat class. Instead of foam kits or plastic covers it wears UHMW slab armour from combat-robot practice. It also has an original hammerhead head, olive drab paint and oversized gloves. It replaces the current hydraulic heavyweights with one that stays electric; above about 110 kg the physics sends you back to hydraulics, where BRUISER and GOLIATH live.
tagline: The heaviest thing electric joints can carry. Every punch is thrown to end it.
proportions: Builder scale 0.933, bulk 1.12: 1.82 m and 103.1 kg compiled, stance COM at 0.94 m. Thigh and shin are 0.41 m each, 8% short of a human's; arm reach 0.69 m, 14% short. Shoulder-joint span is 0.65 m, 38% wider than a human's 0.47 m; hip span 0.25 m. Torso 0.36 × 0.52 × 0.45 m; head 0.21 × 0.19 × 0.22 m. Top-heavy and barrel-chested, with almost no visible neck: the widest robot in the roster.
actuators: Hips (yaw/roll/pitch) and ankles, slot `leg`: MyActuator RMD-X12-P20-320-E, 320 N·m peak / 85 rated, 125 rpm (13.1 rad/s), 2.37 kg, 20:1, 48 V (https://openelab.io/products/myactuator-rmd-x12-p20-actuator). Knees: MyActuator RMD-X15-P20-450-E, 450 N·m / 145 rated, 108 rpm (11.3 rad/s), 3.5 kg, 20.25:1, 72 V (https://openelab.io/products/myactuator-rmd-x15-p20-actuator). Waist yaw and pitch: X12-320 again (320 N·m, 13.1 rad/s), because hooks and overhands come from waist rotation and the upper body is about 60 kg. Shoulders and elbows: RobStride 04, 120 N·m, 200 rpm (20.9 rad/s), 1.42 kg (https://github.com/RobStride/Product_Information); the elbows are sized to swing heavy gloves. Neck: RobStride 02 (servo.neck). 23 actuators totalling 47.2 kg. Gyro core: 195 N·m, 68 N·m·s, 9.1 kg (8.8%), from m·g·h = 955 N·m; with a thin steel rim at r = 0.11 m, the rotor is about 3.2 kg at about 200 m/s rim speed. Catalog ids: plan.x12, plan.x15, qdd.rs04, servo.neck.
materials: Armor 'uhmw' over a black-anodized frame of 'al7075'. UHMW-PE is combat builders' sacrificial 'soak' armour: 940 kg/m³, no-break Izod toughness, soaks hits without sparking. Oversized 21-oz-class boxing gloves, about 0.6 kg each, so it can throw full-power hooks all fight without breaking its own fists (the builder's AR500 'block' stands in until a glove kit exists). No headgear; headBreakImpulseNs 65.
look: Heavyweight, broad and top-heavy. The head is a low, wide, flat-topped hammerhead block, wider than it is deep. It sits sunk between massive rounded shoulder cowls that rise almost to its brow, so the neck is barely visible. Two small round red-orange lenses (#FF4D1A) sit at its far outer corners under a thick overhanging brow ledge, above a heavy chin bar. The face is solid, with no grille or mesh. The chest is a barrel built from thick matte olive-drab (#56613A) UHMW panels, visibly 15–20 mm thick, gouged and scuffed. Exposed button-head bolts fix them to a black-anodized frame (#141516). Large black actuator drums are exposed at the waist, hips and knees under a short UHMW belly plate. The forearm and shin panels are thick, and the oversized gloves are in the corner colour. The feet are wide and square with thick rubber soles. Stencil number 44 on the chest and back; no logos. Default skin: the existing 'military'.
fight_style: A pressure brawler. It walks forward behind a high guard with its chin tucked, cuts the cage off, and smothers kickers in the clinch. Up close it digs uppercuts and hooks to the body, then loads the overhand when the opponent covers up. Low kicks chop the legs of anyone who tries to circle out. Weaknesses: the slowest legs (11.3 rad/s knees under 103 kg), the biggest fall (about 955 J), no sprint, and a gyro that saturates when it has to chase a mover like PYLON.
art_prompt: Photoreal full-body concept render of a heavyweight electric humanoid brawler robot, 1.82 meters tall, broad and top-heavy, three-quarter view, low forward-leaning brawling stance, chin tucked behind oversized blue boxing gloves. Thick matte olive-drab polymer slab armor, visibly gouged and scuffed, bolted with exposed button-head bolts over a black anodized aluminum frame; a barrel chest; massive rounded shoulder cowls rising almost to the top of the head; large black cylindrical actuator drums exposed at the waist, hips and knees. Low, wide, flat-topped hammerhead-shaped head sunk between the shoulder cowls with almost no visible neck, two small red-orange glowing round lenses set far apart at its outer corners under a thick overhanging brow ledge, a heavy chin bar, a solid face with no grille. Wide stance, big square feet with thick rubber soles. Dark studio background, warm key light, dust in the air, photoreal, high detail. No text, no numbers, no logos.

name: PYLON
inspired_by: Draws on the rangy adult-size lineage: Unitree's H1 (1.8 m, 47 kg, 360 N·m knee) and H2 (1.82 m, 70 kg), the tall, lean robots of the class. It fits the ceiling of WHRG 2026's 80 kg Free Combat class at 79.3 kg. It deliberately changes the height (1.89 m, taller than both) and the colours (hi-vis lime with retroreflective silver, not all-black or white and silver). The head is an asymmetric three-lens lozenge instead of an elongated faceless helmet with a crescent outline or a sculpted human face. There are no ball hands and no knit sweater. Its identity is legs and range, not a copied silhouette.
tagline: Six foot two of legs. It hits you from where you can't hit back.
proportions: Builder scale 0.97, bulk 0.78: 1.89 m and 79.3 kg compiled, stance COM at 0.93 m. It has the longest legs in the roster: thigh and shin 0.43 m each, about 0.85 m of leg, 8% short of a human's. Arm reach is 0.69 m, equal to HAYMAKER's, because the builder's arm ratio is fixed and 17% short of a human's 0.83 m. An armScale of 1.12, if added, would give it a human-length 0.77 m jab. Shoulder-joint span is 0.47 m, close to a human's 0.49 m. Hip span is only 0.18 m, the narrowest base in the roster. Torso 0.26 × 0.38 × 0.47 m; head 0.21 × 0.19 × 0.23 m.
actuators: Hips (yaw/roll/pitch), ankles and knees: MyActuator RMD-X12-P20-320-E, 320 N·m peak / 85 rated, 125 rpm (13.1 rad/s), 2.37 kg, 20:1, 48 V (https://openelab.io/products/myactuator-rmd-x12-p20-actuator). The knee uses the X12 instead of the heavier X15 because it is 16% faster, for snapping front kicks; knee torque is 4.0 N·m/kg, above STRIKER's 3.1. Shoulders: RobStride 03, 60 N·m, 195 rpm (20.4 rad/s), 0.90 kg. Elbows: RobStride 06, 36 N·m, 480 rpm (50.3 rad/s), 0.621 kg, for a whip-fast jab (https://www.robstride.com/products/robStride06). Waist: RobStride 04, 120 N·m, 1.42 kg. Neck: RobStride 00, 14 N·m, 0.31 kg (https://github.com/RobStride/Product_Information). 23 actuators totalling 38.2 kg. Lighter alternative: Unitree-class M107 knees (360 N·m, 189 N·m/kg, about 1.9 kg, https://www.unitree.com/h1/), but Unitree publishes no joint speed. Gyro core: 150 N·m, 51 N·m·s, 6.8 kg (8.6%), from m·g·h = 724 N·m. It will saturate most often of the four because of its narrow hips and high COM. Catalog ids: plan.x12, qdd.rs03, qdd.rs06, qdd.rs04, qdd.rs00.
materials: Armor 'carbon' (carbon-fibre shells painted hi-vis) on the chest, forearms, shins and head, over a frame of 'al7075' (dark-anodized upper-arm and thigh tubes and pelvis). Bare fists; the builder's AR500 'block', rendered with black rubber knuckle bumpers. No headgear; headBreakImpulseNs 40, because the head sits highest and is the easiest target for anyone who can reach it.
look: Very tall and lean, with long limbs and narrow hips. The head is a slim upright lozenge, taller than wide and canted slightly forward. One large round violet lens (#B58CFF) is offset to the left, two small violet lenses are stacked vertically on the right, and a short antenna stub sits at the right rear. There is no visor band and no face. Fluorescent hi-vis lime shells (#C6F000) cover a narrow tall chest, the pelvis, forearms and shins. The upper-arm and thigh tubes are exposed dark-anodized aluminium (#1C1D1F). Slim retroreflective silver bands (#C9CCD1, about 3 cm wide) circle every joint. The fists are slim and bare with black rubber knuckle bumpers, and the feet are long, narrow and black. Number 11 runs down the right forearm and across the back; no logos. Default skin: 'factory' now, a new 'hivis' skin later.
fight_style: A distance kicker and out-fighter. It holds range with long front kicks and pokes the jab to measure. It kicks the lead leg of anyone who steps in, and throws the head kick from a range nobody else in the roster can reach. When it gets crowded, sprint resets the distance. Weaknesses: the narrowest base and a high COM, so it spends the most gyro. It hates the clinch and body shots, and gets no clinch ability of its own. FIRECRACKER and HAYMAKER both beat it by getting inside.
art_prompt: Photoreal full-body concept render of a very tall, lean electric humanoid fighting robot, 1.89 meters tall, long legs and narrow hips, three-quarter view, tall upright long-range kickboxing stance with the lead knee slightly raised ready to front-kick, lead hand extended, rear hand at the chin. Fluorescent hi-vis lime-yellow shells on a narrow chest, pelvis, forearms and shins; exposed dark anodized aluminum upper-arm and thigh tubes; slim retroreflective silver bands around every joint; slim bare mechanical fists with black rubber knuckle bumpers. Slim upright lozenge-shaped head, taller than wide, canted slightly forward, with one large round violet glowing lens offset to the left, two small violet lenses stacked vertically on the right, and a short antenna stub at the right rear. Long narrow black feet. Dark studio background, hard side light, photoreal, high detail. No text, no numbers, no logos.
